seoTitle: Bulk robots.txt URL Checker with CSV Export
metaDescription: Check hundreds of URLs against a robots.txt for several crawlers at once and download blocked and allowed results as CSV. Free, in your browser.
intro: Tests a long list of URLs against a robots.txt for one or more crawlers and gives a table or a CSV file.
why:
After a robots.txt change you want to know which of your important URLs are now blocked, for Googlebot, Bingbot and AI crawlers. Testing them one at a time does not scale.

Paste the file and a URL list, name the crawlers, and get the verdict and deciding rule for every pair. Switch to CSV to open it in a spreadsheet. The same longest-match rules as the single-URL tester apply.
howTo: Paste the URLs, one per line, from a sitemap or crawl.
List the crawlers you care about.
Choose table or CSV and copy or download.

faq.q: How many URLs can I test?
Can I see only blocked URLs?
faq.a: Yes, tick the Show only blocked option.
The longest matching pattern, with Allow winning a tie.

faq.q: Where do I get a URL list?
faq.a: The sitemap URL extractor turns a sitemap into a list.
